scope_note: Diagnostic 16-to-18 resume evidence canary. The --resume checkpoint is an immutable, SHA-bound copy of the completed v3 base checkpoint. It restores optimizer/RNG/sampler state and runs updates 17-18 under the same run_id, seed, source snapshot, manifest, normalization, and model protocol. It is not formal training and writes no ledger.
